description: Status for the active part: id, name, editor script, runState (not_run_yet | ok | failed), and the last run volume/bbox/bodyCount when available. While runState is failed those three are null and lastGood carries the last successful run's volume/bbox/bodyCount (the solid still shown). Updates when the active part changes without requiring another run. unjointedParts lists part ids in no joint when the assembly has two or more parts (empty for a single part; a base part with a fixed joint is omitted). jointFailures { count, ids } names the assembly joints that do not solve right now (a broken reference or a conflict, the red chips on the joints strip); list_joints has each joint with its status and reason. featureCount counts insert_* feature blocks, so a freehand set_script is one feature. bodyCount is null until the first run; a finished run that produced no bodies reports 0. Takes return: "status" | "summary" | "full" (MCP default "status": status.script is omitted; "summary" adds status.features; "full" echoes the script). This process also adds webhookRegistered (true when a prompt webhook is registered; the URL and any bearer are not included), queued (prompt messages waiting for read_messages; cancelled prompts are not counted), counts ({ queued, delivered, replied, cancelled }), and last ({ id, state } of the latest prompt, or null).

return.description: How much of status to return: "status" drops status.script, "summary" drops it and adds status.features (the feature strip), "full" keeps the whole script. Over MCP the default is "status"; in the page it is "full". Read the script with get_script.

name: status
